action: Formally close RoboRide channel, reallocate $1,800 reserved inventory to Carlos Ruiz EV account, call Angela Wright to formalize placement partnership, complete overdue Mark Thompson call, update storefront signage and social media
narrative: Howard closed the RoboRide file cleanly this week — updated inventory logs, moved the reserved brake consumables and sensors back to active stock, and called Carlos Ruiz directly. Carlos responded the same day with a $650 purchase order for brake pad sets, hybrid battery diagnostic connectors, and high-voltage insulated gloves, confirming the B2B reallocation is immediately productive. Angela Wright picked up on the first ring; Howard left the call with a written one-page job description in Angela's intake queue and a verbal commitment that she would prioritize displaced Hawkins counter-experience candidates for his part-time opening. Mark Thompson call happened Thursday — Howard acknowledged the delay, confirmed the educator discount on EV and hybrid consumables in writing via email, and got two names from Mark's vocational network as potential part-time counter candidates. The storefront window sign and social media post went up Friday afternoon. The monthly burn continues at -$2,780 net, partially offset by the Carlos order, for a net savings delta of -$2,130 — the best performing tick in four months.
